_readme: FICTIONAL VEHICLE DATA. Every record here is invented for a hackathon prototype.
Registration numbers all begin with DEMO so they cannot be mistaken for real plates
and cannot collide with a real Indian registration format.
submission_scenario binds the MockForm29CAdapter outcome to the chosen vehicle.
This is how demo determinism is achieved WITHOUT a hidden switch: the scenario is a
visible property of a visibly fictional record. 09_QA_TEST_DEMO_RELIABILITY.md
section 6 requires deterministic scenarios and forbids secret bypasses.
